products.title: Energy Storage Solutions
products.subtitle: VinEnergo provides comprehensive BESS solutions ranging from residential to large-scale commercial and industrial applications.

items.title: Box Type BESS
items.description: Energy storage solution for homes and small offices. Compact design, easy to install, and supports up to 5 module stacks.

items.title: Cabinet Type BESS
items.description: Cabinet energy storage system for commercial and industrial operations. Equipped with fire suppression and active cooling.

items.title: Container Based BESS
items.description: Large-scale 20ft container-based energy storage solution. Massive capacity for industrial and utility networks.

features.title: Key Features
features.subtitle: Advanced technology that makes VinEnergo BESS reliable, safe, and efficient.

items.title: Energy Management System
items.description: Intelligent energy management system that optimizes charging/discharging based on consumption patterns and electricity tariffs. Ensures maximum efficiency in every energy cycle.

items.title: Battery Management System
items.description: Advanced battery management system that monitors and optimizes the performance of every battery cell in real-time. Regulates voltage, current, and temperature for maximum battery life.

items.title: Cell-Level Monitoring
items.description: Individual cell-level monitoring to detect anomalies before they become serious problems. Each cell is monitored for voltage, temperature, and capacity with precision.

items.title: Self-Diagnostics
items.description: Automatic diagnostic system that runs periodically to ensure all components are functioning optimally. Detects potential issues before they cause downtime.

items.title: Advanced Management System
items.description: Centralized management platform for monitoring, control, and optimization of entire BESS installations from a single dashboard. Real-time communication capability for SCADA and EMS integration.

items.title: Fire Protection System
items.description: Advanced fire protection system with 3-Level Issue Detection and 5 Levels of Protection. Automatic fire prevention and suppression technology for maximum safety.

benefits.title: How BESS Can Cut Your Electricity Cost
benefits.subtitle: BESS is not just technology — it's a smart investment to reduce your electrical operational costs.

items.title: Grid Stabilization
items.description: Maintains PLN electricity frequency and voltage stability against fluctuation disturbances. BESS acts as an instant energy absorber and releaser to maintain grid balance.

items.title: Backup Power
items.description: Serves as emergency power supply during outages or disturbances in isolated areas. Ensures critical operations continue without interruption.

items.title: Peak Shaving
items.description: Reduces electrical operational costs during energy demand spikes. Store energy during off-peak and use during peak to save costs.

hero.subtitle: Delivering high-precision machining services with advanced technology, experienced engineers, and strict quality control to meet your complex industrial manufacturing needs.

aboutMachining.title: Understanding Machining
aboutMachining.description: Machining is a manufacturing process that uses machine tools to transform raw materials into components with precise dimensions and tolerances. This process involves removing material from a workpiece to achieve the desired shape, size, and surface finish.

highlights.title: CNC Machining
highlights.description: Computer Numerical Control enables high precision and consistent reproducibility.

highlights.title: Precision Tolerances
highlights.description: Achieving tolerances up to ±0.001mm for critical applications.

highlights.title: Quality Control
highlights.description: CMM inspection and rigorous documentation at every stage.

aboutFabrikasi.title: Understanding Fabrication
aboutFabrikasi.description: Fabrication is the process of converting raw materials into finished products or ready-to-use components through various processes such as cutting, bending, welding, and assembly. Unlike machining which focuses on material removal, fabrication emphasizes forming and assembly.

highlights.title: Cutting & Shaping
highlights.description: Precision cutting using laser, plasma, or waterjet.

highlights.title: Welding & Joining
highlights.description: MIG, TIG, and SMAW welding for solid structures.

highlights.title: Bending & Forming
highlights.description: Bending and forming of plates and steel profiles.

highlights.title: Assembly
highlights.description: Component assembly into ready-to-install final products.

methods.title: Machining Methods
methods.subtitle: We employ various machining methods to produce components with the best quality and precision for your needs.

items.title: Milling
items.description: Cutting process using rotating cutters to produce flat surfaces, slots, and complex geometries on workpieces.

items.title: Turning
items.description: Lathe process for creating high-precision cylindrical components using stationary tools on rotating workpieces.

items.title: Grinding
items.description: Surface finishing process using grinding wheels to achieve very precise surface roughness and final dimensions.

items.title: Cutting
items.description: Material cutting process using various methods to achieve desired size and shape.
